items.quote: Den Nachzahlungsbetrag überweisen Sie bitte bis zum 15.12.2026 auf unser Konto.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for the payment: 15.12.2026. This is a company (Hausverwaltung), so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the date is simply the stated due date. 15.12.2026 falls on a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. To arrive by this date via bank transfer, the transfer should be initiated by 14.12.2026 (§675s BGB, one business day for SEPA transfers), but the due date itself remains 2026-12-15.

warnings: The letter states it was delivered by messenger (Bote) directly into the letterbox on 19.11.2026, so no statutory postal deemed-delivery period applies; the due date of 15.12.2026 is a simple stated payment term from a private landlord/management company, not an administrative deadline.

The IBAN (DE61 6805 0101 0005 5133 00) is a valid German account number, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership; verify the payee name matches 'Hausverwaltung Exempeldreisam' before paying, especially if this differs from any IBAN used in previous correspondence.
